headline: Ministry of Economy Comments on When the Conditions for Energy Assistance Will Be Known
summary: The approved budget allocates €250 million for energy assistance, while a figure of €340 million was cited in early November. The Ministry of Economy has not said when conditions will be known.
why: Energy assistance programmes cushion households and businesses against power price shocks and affect public finances.
